link_hygiene_bracket_fires.purpose: the documentation gates must fire an error-severity link_hygiene finding on a snake_case bare bracket
link_hygiene_bracket_fires.documentation:
This is the path-length average of lithium ion number density, summed over all ionization stages from Li$^+$ through fully stripped Li$^{3+}$, along a specified chord through the plasma.

The chord average is defined by

$$
\langle n_{Li} \rangle_L = \frac{1}{L}\int_0^L n_{Li}(s)\,ds
$$

where $n_{Li}(s)$ is the local lithium ion number density in m$^{-3}$, $s$ is path length in meters along the chord, and $L$ is the total chord length in meters.

This quantity weights each path-length element equally and excludes neutral lithium. It differs from the [flux-surface-averaged lithium density at the plasma boundary], which averages over a separatrix, and from [volume-averaged lithium density](name:volume_averaged_lithium_density), which averages over confined plasma volume.

See [injected_bare_name] for the peer quantity.
